title: Capricorn's winter: alarm at 5 AM
caption:
Capricorn in winter: a planner with nine winter tabs, boots rated for minus forty, and a 5 AM alarm on Sunday.
Then it stops the whole schedule to look at the neighbours' lights.
Who's your soft-inside Capricorn?
